items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever get to hear a George Barquet tone?

ctx.x: Did you ever get to hear a George Barquet tone? He said no. No, no, no, no.

Did Tee O play much in the low register? He made a few records, of course, on with P-Rone and they're not too well recorded and you can't hear the clarinet too well just what he's doing. Some of them sound like they were all written out in arrangements, too, but I wondered if he was a good, as they say, a good hop player, too, that could improvise well and all of that. Is he?
